OFFICIAL SYLLABUS

Unit III scope from the course handout

Effect of alloying additions on steel (Mn, Si, Cr, Mo, Ni, V, Ti and W); stainless and tool steels; HSLA and maraging steels; grey, white, malleable, spheroidal and alloy cast irons; copper and its alloys – brass, bronze and cupronickel; aluminium and its alloys; Al–Cu precipitation-strengthening treatment; titanium alloys, magnesium alloys, nickel-based superalloys and shape-memory alloys; properties and applications; overview of materials standards.

STUDY CHECKLIST

Topics listed in the academic calendar

Use this checklist with the Unit III student-notes PDF. It follows the topic sequence in the course handout.

  • Effect of Mn, Si, Cr and Mo on steels
  • Effect of Ni, V, Ti and W on steels
  • Stainless steels and tool steels
  • HSLA and maraging steels
  • Alloy cast irons
  • Copper alloys: brass, bronze and cupronickel
  • Aluminium alloys and Al–Cu precipitation strengthening
  • Titanium, magnesium and nickel-based superalloys
  • Shape-memory alloys and overview of materials standards
